subtopics.content: 1.1 - 1.5 Concept, uses, types, charging, testing, and maintenance
subtopics.objective: Definition and distinction of motor vehicle batteries; lead-acid and nickel-alkaline construction and ratings. Electrolyte preparation, safety rules, charging modes, specific gravity test (hydrometer), cell voltage, polarity, over-charging symptoms, and safe storage.

subtopics.content: 2.1 - 2.4 Purpose, circuit diagram, motor types, repairs
subtopics.objective: Starting system components (battery, flywheel, starter motor, switch, solenoid). Reading/drawing circuit diagrams. Axial vs inertia starter motors and pinion engagements. Dismantling, assembling, brush/bushing replacement, commutator soldering, and troubleshooting.

subtopics.content: 3.1 - 3.6 Purpose, circuit diagrams, coil operation, timing, fault repairs
subtopics.objective: Components of ignition assembly (switch, coil, distributor, capacitor, HT leads, spark plugs). Construction and operation of ignition coil. Conventional contact breaker vs electronic ignition systems. Retarded/advanced ignition timing faults, hard starting, jerking, and backfiring repair.

subtopics.content: 4.1 - 4.4 Purpose, alternator, circuit diagram, faults and repairs
subtopics.objective: Components (switch, battery, cables, alternator, voltage regulator). Alternator construction, AC to DC rectification, diode testing/replacement, brush/bearing replacement, and fixing charging failure.

subtopics.content: 5.1 - 5.4 Purpose, head lamps, circuit diagram, maintenance
subtopics.objective: Obligatory vs non-obligatory lights. Headlamp types, setting, alignment, and features. Reading lighting circuit diagrams. Repairing broken lenses, bulb failures, open circuits, and short circuits.

Uses and components of auxiliary systems: water temp gauge, oil pressure gauge, fuel gauge, horn relay, wiper switch, screen washer pump, indicator, door switch. Troubleshooting and repair procedures for auxiliary system failures.
